about: Print runs (v0.5.1, api/print_runs.py, docs/shop.md "Print runs"): printings made in a known number of copies, which packs never deal more often than were printed. By Scryfall ID; in_boosters names the MTGJSON booster sheets that hold it. Every serialized printing Scryfall lists (is:serialized): copies is the serial's denominator, each count from Wizards of the Coast's collecting articles or product pages, checked against the serial on the card's scan. Since v0.6.1, every Alpha and Beta printing: its source names an entry of sheet_runs, which gives the copies of each sheet printed and where they were read, and sheets how often the printing appears on each; copies is their sum (sheet_runs_method).
sheet_runs_method: Alpha, Beta and Unlimited were printed on 121-card sheets, one each of rares, uncommons and commons, with the basic lands on all three (Crystal Keep: a land in about 3.31% of rare, 21.5% of uncommon and 38.02% of common slots). A rarity's copies of each card are the number of its sheets printed. A printing's copies are the sum, over the sheets, of how often it appears on the sheet (MTGJSON's booster sheet weights, out of 121) times that sheet's copies.

lea.source: Scrye magazine's table of copies printed of each card by rarity ('How rare is that Black Lotus anyways?'), quoted at https://forums.collectors.com/discussion/comment/4548107/ and https://forums.collectors.com/discussion/comment/4596775/ (2005): Alpha 1,100 of each rare, 4,500 of each uncommon, 15,900 of each common. Star City Games, 'All About Alpha' (2012, https://articles.starcitygames.com/articles/all-about-alpha/), gives the same 1,100 and 4,500 and rounds the commons to 16,000. Wizards of the Coast's Alpha, Beta, Unlimited product page (http://www.wizards.com/magic/tcg/productarticle.aspx?x=mtg_tcg_abu_productinfo, archived 2008-09-04 at web.archive.org) gives 2.6 million cards in all.

leb.source: Scrye magazine's table of copies printed of each card by rarity ('How rare is that Black Lotus anyways?'), quoted at https://forums.collectors.com/discussion/comment/4548107/ and https://forums.collectors.com/discussion/comment/4596775/ (2005): Beta 3,200 of each rare, 13,400 of each uncommon, 47,800 of each common. Their sheets come to 7.79 million cards, Crystal Keep's 7.8 million (http://www.crystalkeep.com/magic/products/limited.php, archived 2007-04-06 at web.archive.org); Wizards of the Coast's product page gives 7.3 million, so these counts may be up to 7% high.
